serverInfo.name: VideoText
serverInfo.description: AI video transcription, subtitle generation, and translation. Upload a video or paste a YouTube URL to get a transcript, SRT/VTT subtitles, summary, and chapters in minutes.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Upload a video file and get a transcript with speaker labels, chapters, and summary. Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM.

file.description: Video file to transcribe (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM)

tools.name: transcribe_youtube
tools.description: Transcribe a YouTube video by URL. No download required.

tools.name: generate_subtitles
tools.description: Generate SRT or VTT subtitle files from a video file or YouTube URL.

file.description: Video file (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) or YouTube URL

tools.name: translate_subtitles
tools.description: Translate an SRT or VTT subtitle file to another language. Timestamps preserved.

file.description: SRT or VTT subtitle file to translate

target_language.description: Target language code (e.g., es, fr, ja, hi)
